title: Chapter 162 Magical Yin-Yang
content:
Chapter 162 Magical Yin-Yang

Under the unbelievable eyes of everyone, Concubine Yan shot Yan Dan who was stunned directly, and then hugged him in her arms, standing upright and proud of many soldiers.

Looking at the woman in front of him, it seems that he wants to fight against his tens of thousands of troops with his own strength, which is too self-sufficient!

"Madam, surrender. It is absolutely impossible for you to escape from the package of my tens of thousands of troops. Surrender obediently is your only way out. Otherwise, die!" Zhang Liao said coldly.

"Hahaha! You damned people, if it weren't for you, how could my husband be where he is today, and his reputation would be ruined!" Concubine Yan laughed wildly, her husband's unfeeling just now had already made her heart so fragile The unbearable woman became paranoid.

Following Concubine Yan's laughter, the surrounding air began to freeze, and waves of waves surged through it.

"No, this woman seems to have other preparations, and she must not let him succeed. Archer, shoot me an arrow!" Zhang Liao's complexion changed, and he realized that something seemed wrong in front of him.

Bang bang sounded one after another, it was the sound of bowstrings leaving the body, tens of thousands of arrows rushed towards the woman in front of her, moving forward without hesitation, densely covering her everywhere.

However, under the horrified eyes of everyone, these pierced through the woman's body, but there was no sound of arrows entering the body.

Because those arrows directly penetrated the bodies of this woman and Yan Dan, and rushed toward both sides.

"This, how is this possible? How did she do it? Isn't he a man or a god?" Zhang Liao couldn't believe it. The things in front of him were completely beyond his imagination. , have seen God.

"The situation in front of me reminds me of a sect's secret technique that His Majesty once mentioned to me." Zhao Yun hesitated, showing that he was not sure whether it was that secret technique in front of him!

"Oh, Your Majesty once mentioned this situation, Zilong, tell me quickly, and let me know about it!" Xu Huang asked quickly after hearing this.

"Yes, Zilong, don't hide it, mother-in-law, mother-in-law, she doesn't look like a man!" Zhang Fei and others also hurriedly urged.

"Well, on the way to visit the Yan Kingdom, His Majesty once mentioned to his ministers that there is a secret technique in Taoism that can cast illusions, cover people's sight, and transform into an illusory person. And he I escaped from the pre-prepared secret passage by myself, so that no one would notice. On the contrary, people think that the person who casts the illusion is a person with great supernatural powers, so I feel afraid." Zhao Yun's expression was full of memories In it, he described what he heard from Zhong Yu.

"It's really strange that there is such a method in the world. The ancient sages are really unpredictable!" Zhang Liao was amazed when he heard it, and he was full of awe for those who created such mysterious exercises.

"Yeah, this method is really ingenious!" Xu Huang also agreed.

"Not good, let's forget that since this method is an illusion, and the purpose of escape is achieved by confusing our eyes, then the place where these two people are standing must have a secret path. At this moment, they must have escaped for a long time. It’s a long way away!” Ma Chao, who was standing by the side and had been listening to these people talking without making a sound, suddenly woke up.

"What Meng Qi said is true, if you let him escape, there will be endless troubles, I will go and search for it soon!" When he came back to his senses, Zhang Liao also realized for a while.

"I'm going to investigate right now, let these two people escape under the noses of my tens of thousands of troops, and if the news spreads, people all over the world will laugh at my incompetence!" Take it very seriously.

With the rattling sound and the sound of horseshoes, Ma Chao rushed towards the place where Concubine Yan had just stood with his hundreds of guards.

But after arriving at the same place, Ma Chao stabbed at Concubine Yan's body with the silver spear in his hand, and with a stir, his vigorous internal force raged and flew in Concubine Yan's body.

It directly shattered the figure, like glass, full of cracks, spreading steadily, and finally turned into a butterfly and flew away with a bang.

"Damn it, how dare you bully me, if I see you in the future, I will surely tear you to pieces!" Standing where he was, Ma Chao raised his head to the sky and roared, his tone full of anger and deep-seated hatred.

This can't be blamed on him. It is really embarrassing for what it is doing today. There are more than 40,000 troops, surrounded by two people, one of them is a woman, and a man who is in a coma. Under the nose, to escape.

This kind of humiliation is not something ordinary people can bear. After the news spread today, other generals in the empire will laugh at them.

I'm afraid that even the seven kingdoms of the world will laugh at the northern barbarians after hearing about this deed. They are really ignorant, and they can't even see through this kind of blindfold.

As the commander-in-chief of this army, the five of them, Ma Chao, were the first to bear the brunt.

Faced with such a situation that may be encountered in the future, how can Ma Chao not feel angry? Not to mention him, even Zhao Yun and other good-tempered people behind him were annoyed for a while, and their faces were a little red.

"This man is really treacherous. He insulted us so much. It's a shame today. When we see him in the future, we will definitely have a divorce with him!" Zhang Liao made a promise to Zhao Yun and others beside him.

"Exactly, if I see you someday, I will definitely die!" Xu Huang also responded.

"Now our goal can be said to have been achieved. The 30,000 troops of Yandan Kingdom who escaped from the city have been wiped out. Only their commander, Yandan, escaped alone. Now that I have completed the mission, it is time to go back and report to His Majesty. Report the results of the battle, and apologize by the way!" Putting down the anger in his heart, Zhang Liao forcibly calmed down, and he clearly realized what he should do most at this moment.

"Yeah, I've been waiting for a long time. Your Majesty must have been impatient. If you procrastinate, your Majesty will not be too harsh, but you will definitely be unhappy!" Zhao Yun also realized.

"That being the case, let's take stock of the battlefield, and I'll head back to the army!" Seeing that no one objected, Zhang Liao ordered.

Tens of thousands of troops followed the order of their general and began to clean the battlefield. They wanted to jump out of the trophies on the battlefield, and their companions who were seriously injured. Meat sauce, there are less than one in a thousand wounded who can survive.

But they also have to try their best to treat him, because no one knows whether he will be the next injured person. Now that they have saved these people, someone will come to save them next time. They still understand this truth very well.
